title: Privacy Metrics for Synthetic Data
summary: A Python toolkit implementing distance/similarity and attack-based privacy metrics for evaluating disclosure risk in synthetic tabular data. It imports SDMetrics' NewRowSynthesis and SDV's SingleTableMetadata to structure and compute some of these privacy metrics.
evidence: synthprivacymetrics/metrics/distance_metrics.py:8-9 imports NewRowSynthesis from sdmetrics.single_table and SingleTableMetadata from sdv.metadata
needs: No explicit call site shown for NewRowSynthesis or SingleTableMetadata usage beyond import statements
